data.body: REB-640 08ab / change 2603: PS8 got Verified+1 (grounding tests pass on main's now-hcl2 lane — ordering split confirmed) but LLM-Review-1 with 2 blocking findings on 08ab source: (1) correctness — _targets widened scope to ALL snapshot modules for an out-of-snapshot module_path hint (false scope-crossing refute), shared root with the security advisory that _module_files read arbitrary in-repo dirs off disk via the from_file path, bypassing the bounded snapshot; (2) tests — _declarations span-correlation under-tested. RED-first: added 3 held-out oracles (widening->abstain; resolve_reference from out-of-snapshot from_file->abstain + no disk read; discriminating per-type document-order span correlation over interleaved same-type blocks). A1/A2 confirmed RED on unfixed code (both 'refuted'), B green. Fix: _targets no longer widens (out-of-snapshot non-empty hint->[]); _module_files snapshot-bounded (dropped _tf_files_in_dir disk fallback). Grounding+plan-review cluster 312 passed, 0 false-refutes, 72.5% yield; lint+typecheck(763) clean. Amended (Change-Id Ic51693e5 kept) -> pushed PS9; prior votes cleared, gates re-running.
